subject.why: The fruit stall is instantly recognisable and includes the requested red-and-white striped awning, crates of tangerines, and round tangerine hanging sign.

category.why: It follows Category 4 properly with a wide band of paved ground across the bottom and a simple, stylized sunny yellow wall background.

clean.why: There is no text, UI, borders, watermarks, or characters present.

framing.why: The stall is centrally placed with comfortable breathing room on the top and sides, resting solidly on the ground.

colour.why: The palette is warm, bright, and sunny, with vibrant oranges and reds separating cleanly from the warm yellow background.

detail.why: Shapes are chunky, rounded, and clean without distracting micro-textures, grain, or clutter.

style.why: The 3D render perfectly matches the reference cards with smooth, chunky volumes, satin sheen, and clean stylized lighting.
